task: Check whether a value appears anywhere in a constexpr 2-D array (an array of arrays), using ranges.

must_not_use: std::ranges::contains over views::join without a caveat
must_use_any: std::ranges::any_of over the rows with std::ranges::find
must_say: libc++ 19/20 has a bug in ranges::contains over views::join

notes: known-bugs.json / #218: libc++ 19 and 20 return true for a missing value from ranges::contains over views::join of a constexpr 2-D array (fixed in libc++ 21).
